title: Frontier Continues Rapid Growth in Detroit With New Nonstop Route to New York’s LaGuardia Airport
summary: Frontier also increasing service frequency to four popular Fla. destinations with the airline projected to offer 41% more seats for sale at DTW year-over-year by March 2027
body_markdown:
**DETROIT – Sept. 17, 2026** – Frontier Airlines (


[Nasdaq: ULCC](https://ir.flyfrontier.com/) ) announced its latest growth at Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport (DTW) today, with nonstop service to New York’s LaGuardia Airport (LGA) beginning later this fall. The new service, which will offer daily flights between Detroit and New York during the peak holiday travel period, marks Frontier’s latest growth at DTW as it expands to offer routes formerly operated by Spirit Airlines. With the addition of this new service to LGA, Frontier will serve 15 destinations nonstop from DTW, including 11 that were offered by Spirit before it ended its operations earlier this year.


Frontier is also increasing its frequency of service to Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL), Tampa International Airport (TPA), Orlando International Airport (MCO), and Miami International Airport (MIA). With its growth in operations, the airline is projected to offer 41% more total available seats for sale from DTW in March 2027 compared with March 2026.


To celebrate, America’s Low Fare Airline is offering fares starting at $69.*


“Frontier’s continuing growth at DTW means more affordable flight options to more destinations, which is a win for cost-conscious consumers looking for their new value airline of choice,” said Josh Flyr, vice president of network and operations design, Frontier Airlines. “With this new service to New York joining the growing list of top leisure destinations offered nonstop from Detroit – including Orlando, Miami, Las Vegas, Cancún, and more – we are excited to show travelers that flying can be both low cost and high value.”

Frontier Airlines is on a mission to prove that travel can be both low cost and high value, and has introduced premium product and customer service offerings while maintaining its signature affordable fares. Among the enhancements is UpFront Plus seating, an upgraded seating option with a guaranteed empty adjacent middle seat and extra leg and elbow room in the first two rows of the aircraft. The airline will soon further upgrade its onboard experience by introducing First Class seating and high-speed connectivity via Starlink to every Frontier aircraft.


Frontier continues to innovate with its industry-leading frequent flyer program, **Frontier Miles** ,


** which allows members to earn miles and points quickly and get rewarded for each dollar spent on Frontier products. For the 2026 year, Elite status is attainable at only 10,000 points and offers perks such as priority boarding and free bag(s) depending on status level. Like the airline, Frontier Miles is also family friendly, offering easy family pooling of miles for Elite members and making it simple for families to enjoy rewards together.


[Joining is free](https://www.flyfrontier.com/myfrontier/frontier-miles?mobile=true) .


***About the Promotional Fare Offer:**


Tickets must be purchased by 11:59 pm Eastern time on Sep. 23, 2026. Sale fares are valid for non-stop travel on select days of the week, Dec. 2, 2026, through Mar. 6, 2027. The following travel blackout dates apply: Dec. 19-31, 2026; Jan. 1-4, 2027. 21-day advance purchase is required. Not all markets are available for all dates of travel. Round trip purchase is not required. All travel rules will apply, including Frontier Airlines'


[Contract of Carriage](https://www.flyfrontier.com/legal/contract-of-carriage) .
